intent: Apply T01 to an uploaded crop against the loaded KiCad/Gerber inputs, export and display the result
location_owner: PCB data ABI: pcb_inputs_verify, pcb_roi_locate, pcb_roi_verify; T01 consumes verified source-coordinate ROI
audit: One native slice and separate agent observation at every gate; exact facts/digests carried mechanically; no auto approval or workflow loop
failure: HALTED on native, location, coverage, policy or audit failure; preserve and stop, no retry
output: Fresh candidate KiCad/Gerber and correctly labelled side-by-side display; complete sources outside selected feature aliases unchanged
scope: Graphic filled zero-stroke F.Cu circle profile; arbitrary crop position, not arbitrary unsupported native semantics. Owner PENDING_USER; independent NOT_RUN; electrical/manufacturing NOT_ESTABLISHED
execution: Only start,21reviews and necessary completion polls; no probes, no-op commands, wrappers, source/settings/Git edits. On REPORT_AND_STOP deliver supplied markdown directly.
setup: User starts project-local Start_T01_Native_Launcher.command once per working session. Embedded clients use files only; native bridge launches each fresh job. Missing/stale bridge halts before job allocation. No MCP, network, install or global configuration.
lifecycle: One active job per checkout; overlapping commands/starts halt without replacing it. Completed jobs stay read-only. New inputs create a fresh job after a terminal outcome. Same inputs and implementation cannot automatically retry a failed job. Idle/interrupted workers halt; never resume. Runner stops at terminal outcome.
attachment_ingestion: macOS Local Code adapter reads native app-staged project-root copy by current attachment label; never opens original Desktop path or enumerates directories. Canonical Unicode and macOS timestamp-space variants only; conflicting bytes halt. Missing staged bytes halt before creating a job. Legacy --crop remains explicit-path input for other callers.
pagination: 100-record bound pages for complete source inventory, inspection and source comparison; crop-only inspect_all/compare_all verbs; no fixed target/source-object count caps. Counts bind to the actual verified source inventory. All 21 observation gates retained; full page coverage rechecked before planning.
policy: Crop controlled-English version 2, 16 clauses. R09 handles strictly source-nested concentric pairs without an invented facing direction. Both sites remain selected and all ordinary numeric/clearance/port/final-assembly constraints remain unchanged.
